items.raw_excerpt: The food in 10 major Dutch cities has become less healthy over the past decade, according to new research by Amsterdam UMC. Health executives from the 10 cities have written to health minister Sophie Hermans urging her to speed up a promised food law that would let councils limit unhealthy outlets, Het Parool reported on Tuesday. The researchers scored 31 types of food outlet, from greengrocers to fast-food chains. The scores combined expert ratings with checks of more than 83,000...
items.summary_en: New research from Amsterdam UMC found that food in 10 major Dutch cities has become less healthy over 10 years. Health leaders from these cities asked the health minister to speed up a food law. The law would let local councils limit unhealthy food shops.
items.summary_ko: 암스테르담 UMC의 새 연구에 따르면 지난 10년 동안 네덜란드 10개 주요 도시의 음식이 더 건강에 나빠졌습니다. 이 도시들의 보건 책임자들은 보건 장관에게 음식 관련 법안을 서둘러 마련해 달라고 요청했습니다. 이 법안은 지방 의회가 건강에 나쁜 음식점 수를 제한할 수 있게 해 줍니다.

items.raw_excerpt: A year after winning the first Women's T20 World Cup for the Blind, India's players say they still lack grounds and jobs; captain Deepika T.C. awaits a house site.

items.raw_excerpt: It’s official: Norway has been ranked as the hardest country in the world for international residents to settle in and build a social life, according to a major global survey. But does this really come as a surprise?

items.raw_excerpt: Falconry has deep roots across many cultures, but Saudi Arabia has increasingly become one of the places where those traditions meet.
